headline: 18 suspects accused in the 2021 killing of Haiti's president being extradited to U.S.
context: Eighteen suspects who were arrested in the July 2021 killing of Haitian President Jovenel Moïse were being extradited to the U.S. on Sunday to face justice in Florida.
